description: Core acquisition engine — structured-first source adapters (Wikidata SPARQL, PetScan, official dumps, residual wikitext via mwparserfromhell, generic HTTP fallback) that fetch sweeping cultural/historical/linguistic categories into raw rows with full provenance, behind a uniform adapter interface with caching, rate-limiting, and category-spec input.

tasks.title: T1-US-001: Scaffold the pinakes_engine Python package
tasks.description:
As a developer, I need an installable package skeleton so every later subsystem has a home.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Create pyproject.toml with package name 'pinakes_engine', Python >=3.11, and dev deps: pytest, mypy, ruff
- Create src/pinakes_engine/__init__.py and src/pinakes_engine/acquire/__init__.py
- `pip install -e .` succeeds in a clean venv
- Type checks pass (mypy)
- Lint passes (ruff)

Project context: pinakes-engine — see PLAN.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/prior-art.md. Work in the repo root (src/pinakes_engine/). This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/acquisition-engine'.

tasks.title: T1-US-002: Define the RawRecord and Provenance data classes
tasks.description:
As a developer, I need a uniform in-memory representation of an acquired row plus its provenance before normalization.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Define a frozen dataclass Provenance(source, source_url, source_query, retrieved_at, confidence)
- Define a dataclass RawRecord(fields: dict[str,str], provenance: Provenance)
- retrieved_at is an ISO-8601 UTC string; confidence is a float in [0,1]
- Tests pass (pytest) covering construction and validation of out-of-range confidence
- Type checks pass (mypy)

Project context: pinakes-engine — see PLAN.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/prior-art.md. Work in the repo root (src/pinakes_engine/). This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/acquisition-engine'.

tasks.title: T1-US-003: Define the SourceAdapter abstract interface and registry
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want every source behind one interface so the orchestrator can call them uniformly.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Define abstract base SourceAdapter with method fetch(category_spec) -> Iterator[RawRecord]
- Define a register/lookup registry keyed by adapter id (e.g. 'wikidata-sparql', 'petscan')
- Adapters declare a name and the category-spec source.type they handle
- Tests pass (pytest) verifying registry lookup raises a clear error for unknown adapter ids
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T1-US-004: Implement the category-spec YAML loader
tasks.description:
As a user, I want to declare a category in YAML so a category becomes a reproducible input.

- Loader returns a typed CategorySpec dataclass

tasks.title: T1-US-005: Build an HTTP client with on-disk caching and rate-limiting
tasks.description:
As a developer, I need polite, reproducible network access so adapters are testable and don't hammer endpoints.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Implement a client wrapping requests with a configurable per-host rate limit and exponential backoff on 429/5xx
- Responses cached on disk keyed by (url, params); cache hits skip the network
- A configurable User-Agent string identifies the project (per Wikimedia policy)
- Tests pass (pytest) using a mocked transport: cache hit avoids a second call; 429 triggers backoff then retry
- Type checks pass (mypy)

Project context: pinakes-engine — see PLAN.md, docs/data-model.md, docs/prior-art.md. Work in the repo root (src/pinakes_engine/). This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/acquisition-engine'.

tasks.title: T1-US-006: Implement the Wikidata SPARQL adapter
tasks.description:
As a user, I want categories defined by a SPARQL query so 'every Peruvian dish' is a query, not a scrape.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- POST/GET the query in category_spec.source.query to query.wikidata.org/sparql with format=json via the cached HTTP client
- Map each SPARQL binding row to a RawRecord, preserving the item QID and all selected variables
- Set provenance.source='wikidata', source_url to the item URI, source_query to the SPARQL text
- Tests pass (pytest) against a recorded SPARQL JSON fixture (no live network)
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T1-US-007: Implement the PetScan adapter
tasks.description:
As a user, I want to pull Wikipedia category-tree membership lists so categories that live as wiki categories are first-class.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Call petscan.wmcloud.org with the spec's PetScan parameters (categories, depth, combination, optional WDQS) requesting format=json
- Map each result page/item to a RawRecord including title, pageid, and Wikidata QID when present
- Set provenance.source='petscan' with the PetScan query URL recorded in source_query
- Tests pass (pytest) against a recorded PetScan JSON fixture
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T1-US-008: Implement the wikitext adapter using mwparserfromhell
tasks.description:
As a user, I want to extract rows from 'List of...' wikitables and infoboxes that SPARQL/PetScan cannot reach.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Fetch raw wikitext for a page via the MediaWiki API (cached client)
- Use mwparserfromhell to extract rows from the first matching wikitable and/or named template parameters specified in the category spec
- Each extracted row becomes a RawRecord with provenance.source='wikitext' and the page URL
- Tests pass (pytest) parsing a recorded wikitext fixture containing a table and an infobox
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T1-US-009: Implement the dump adapter for Getty and Pleiades
tasks.description:
As a user, I want to ingest official bulk dumps so authoritative vocabularies can anchor entities.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Read a local Getty N-Triples dump and emit RawRecords for AAT/TGN/ULAN entries (id, preferred label, type)
- Read a local Pleiades JSON/CSV export and emit RawRecords for places (id, name, lat, lon, cross-links)
- Provenance records source='getty_aat'|'getty_tgn'|'getty_ulan'|'pleiades' and the record URI; respect ODC-By attribution by storing the license string
- Tests pass (pytest) against small recorded dump fixtures for both sources
- Type checks pass (mypy)
